label: Resistive shielding
subgoals: Reduce the net to near capacitance, resistance and far capacitance
Compute the shielding time constant R times C2
Compare the time constant with the driver's ramp time

label: Charge matching over a ramp
subgoals: Compute the ratio of the time constant to the ramp time
Evaluate the fraction of the far capacitance that charges during the ramp
Add the near capacitance to get the effective capacitance

label: Iterating with the cell table
subgoals: Look up the ramp time at the current capacitance
Recompute the effective capacitance for that ramp
Repeat until the ramp time and effective capacitance agree
